_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY. The bot never reads this file; the real list is ignore_list.json. Copy blocks from here into it.
_how_it_works: A list with one block per page. A block says which pages it covers and what the bot must leave alone.
_page: Page title or a full https://bluearchive.wiki/wiki/... URL.
_range: [first, last] = covers Page/first to Page/last (numbered subpages only).
_all_subpages: true = covers every page below the page, at any depth (Page/1, Page/2/1, ...).
_ignore: "everything" (the default) = the bot does not touch the page. Or a list of template names = the bot keeps those templates from the wiki and still updates the rest.
_defaults: If none of single_page, range, all_subpages is given, the block covers the page itself.

_comment: Page A: ignore the single page, ignore everything
Page B: ignore range 1 to 9, ignore templates Alpha and Beta, ignore all subpages
Page D: ignore the single page, everything, all subpages
Page E: ignore the single page, only template Charlie
